name: VeriWorld task dataset
description: Executable 3D test-task definitions, deterministic seed/parameter fixtures and public CLI recipes for VeriWorld. The dataset is not a collection of model-run results. The separately distributed VeriWorld binary and user-configured model API are required to execute tasks.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: Task catalogue and runtime recipe documentation
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: Task objectives, verifier metrics and source paths describe the pinned release implementation. Recipes document representative one-round public CLI installation checks; no model outcome is used as a task definition.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: Deterministic initialization fixture generation and lossless CSV serialization
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: The released generators produce parameter objects from task-specific seeds and configuration. Each fixture retains generator identity, source hash, parameter hash and JSON values. CSV columns preserve these objects as JSON strings. No rendering or model inference is required to read a fixture; model actions are not fixture labels.

rai:dataCollection: Synthetic task initialization produced by the versioned VeriWorld generators and documented live UE scenes. The catalogue records executable objectives and runtime metrics. No human subjects or scraped personal data were used to generate task instances.
rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: This metadata describes the paper-artifacts-2026-11-06-rc3 task source with the paper-artifacts-2026-11-03-rc1 runtime binary. Metadata revision date is not an experiment collection date.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Reference task/seed/generator configurations are serialized to CSV with parameter objects stored as JSON strings and source/parameter SHA256 digests preserved. Runtime recipes are documentation, not trial outcomes. No experimental success/failure records are included in these three record sets.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Task objectives and metrics are documented from the released implementation. Reference quantities come from deterministic generators or the live engine state. Execution outcomes are computed by the task verifier; no crowd or model judge labels the fixture dataset.
rai:dataLimitations: Eleven task families are documented. Ninety offline fixtures cover eight families; LightWar and photoreal grounding use live runtime/scene configuration. The fixtures are not exhaustive seed coverage. Legacy TunnelNav3D uses fixed construction seed 99 for rendered tunnel waypoints. This synthetic task release does not establish real-world performance, safety, cross-platform score equivalence or universal model API availability.
rai:dataBiases: Selected synthetic scenes, geometry, task generators and English instructions constrain the distribution. Asset appearance and task coverage need not represent natural sensors, real-world environments or social spatial reasoning.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Task records contain synthetic parameters and software instructions, with no human-subject or scraped personal data. Creator identities/contact details describe the public scholarly authorship, not task participants.
rai:dataUseCases: Reproduce task initialization, inspect executable verifier definitions, run controlled spatial-reasoning evaluations and test supported model API configurations. The task fixtures alone provide no measured model performance and are not a safety or deployment certification.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Reproducible task definitions can improve evaluation transparency. Overgeneralizing synthetic benchmark scores could mislead robotics or embodied-system deployment decisions. Explicit scope, source versions and deterministic verifiers help readers interpret results.
